name: pi-audit-gap
description: Goal-coverage supervision extension for pi.dev — reads pi-goal-x's goal ledger, generates Definition-of-Done checklists with a sparse high-level auditor (Opus lane), verifies coverage with a cheap model (DeepSeek lane), and injects [STEER:*] Tier-3 gaps before goal archival.
